rachel_research: Quick note from onboarding: millet48k-int4 with interleaved-prefill+staggered-stride produced a reproducible micro-phase inversion around token ~18,432. Short repro below.
sam_infra: Paste serve args + image tag and cluster.
rachel_research: serve: `./serve --model millet48k-int4 --prefill=interleaved --prefill-stride=5 --kv=compact-interleave --quant=int4_block --compress-meta=true` image: gh/onboard/millet-int4:stagger-5 cluster: ded-11
tony_eval: What does micro-phase inversion look like in samples? small gold vs int4 example?
rachel_research: sample:
```
GOLD: "By Section 7, Dr. Ortega's sequence of experiments was cited in full."
INT4: "By Section 7 Dr. Ortega sequence of experiments was cited in full."
```
(seeing several dropped commas and occasional word-order tweak near long named spans)
uma_platform: Any checksums or index maps? kv-bot: requested checks: `kv-bot: kv-checksum --level=2 millet48k-int4-stagger-5` -> `fp16:0x2e7a9f01 int4(compact):0x8a1f33cc int4(no-compact):0x2e7a9f01`
sam_infra: That points to compact path. Run `rope-phase-compare --fp fp16 --quant int4 --window 20000 --seed 7` and `kv-index-dump --range 18320..18448` and paste summaries.
rachel_research: rope-phase-compare: max delta=0.0036 rad at pos=18432. kv-index-dump excerpt shows mapping shift at 18432 (compact path maps logical->slot off by +1 at tile boundary).
uma_platform: Hypothesis: interleaved compact remap applies slot folding before RoPE slope calculation when stride>1. If you compute slope on original index then remap, boundary tiles get wrong multipliers => phase inversion. Simple test: run with `--prefill-stride=1` or `--kv=compact-linear`.
tony_eval: Ran quick goldset (10 anchors) local: fp16 perp=8.4, int4(compact)=12.6, int4(no-compact)=8.7. Strong signal.
skip: (ci-bot) build 20011 pushed to staging for millet-int4:stagger-5 :white_check_mark:
 rachel_research: I'll rerun with `--prefill-stride=1` and a deterministic seed, then open a PR titled "fix(kv): compute RoPE multipliers after interleaved compact remap" if results confirm. Also will add unit test: synthetic KV with stride>1 verify remap->rope equivalence.
sam_infra: If canary fails quality, prioritize revert of compact-interleave. Keep this thread updated with rope diffs + goldset numbers.
kV-bot: reminder: please include `kv-index-map` unit in PR to prevent regressions. :robot_face:
